discriminating_question: Is the source of record a schema'd format where every entity carries the same fields and an empty field is a DETECTABLE STATE -- or prose/markdown that LOOKS structured (tables, headers) while nothing enforces completeness?

verdict_vocabulary.STRUCTURED: schema'd format, uniform fields, absence detectable; may include enforced or convention-held uniformity that measured 100% conformant AND has a live mechanical consumer that would fail loud
verdict_vocabulary.STRUCTURED_UNENFORCED: schema'd format, measured fully conformant TODAY, but conformance is held by discipline -- no gate/lint refuses a nonconforming entry; the green is care, not a control
verdict_vocabulary.STRUCTURED_NONUNIFORM: structured format (JSON/JSONL/YAML) whose entities do NOT carry the same fields; absence is NOT a detectable state (missing vs explicitly-none indistinguishable)
verdict_vocabulary.HONEST_PROSE_RECORD: markdown/prose that is a RECORD (provenance, rationale, naming act) and claims no compiled-from role; nothing programmatic reads it -- fine AS a record per the ruling
verdict_vocabulary.DERIVED_RENDER: prose rendering of a structured source; the structured sibling is the record and wins on disagreement
verdict_vocabulary.MASQUERADE: prose/markdown functioning as a source of record that downstream work compiles from or treats as SSOT
